text: Valuation is very likely to become the next major issue for the hedge fund industry, because most jurisdictions lack regulatory oversight of valuation and the industry generally lacks self-discipline and internal controls.
citation: Kaal, Hedge Fund Valuation Retailization, Regulation, and Investor Suitability (2009). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1428387
